# Third-party notices

This pack builds on [k2-multiplayer-base](https://github.com/Alakazam-211/k2-multiplayer-base)
(the multiplayer kit), which carries its own NOTICE: yrs (MIT), similar (Apache-2.0),
thiserror (MIT OR Apache-2.0), and `unicode-ident` (`(MIT OR Apache-2.0) AND Unicode-3.0`,
build-time only; Unicode-3.0 is OSI-approved and permissive).

All dependencies are checked by `scripts/check-licences.sh` against the allow-list
(MIT, Apache-2.0, BSD, ISC, Zlib, plus Unicode-3.0).
